:::{#cor-exp-sum}
#### exponential of a difference

The exponential of a difference
is the exponential of the first term
divided by the exponential of the second term:

$$\exp{a-b} = \frac{\exp{a}}{\exp{b}}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-exp-difference}
#### Exponential of a difference

With $a = 5$ and $b = 2$,
$\exp{5 - 2} = \exp{3} \approx 20.09$,
and $\frac{\exp{5}}{\exp{2}} \approx \frac{148.41}{7.389} \approx 20.09$.

:::
